Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the contract without cause, with immediate effect, and without paying for the work you have already performed.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 30 days prior written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work passes to the client upon delivery, before you have received full payment for the deliverables.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. Before signing the agreement, I would like to propose a couple of minor adjustments. - Regarding the termination terms, the relevant clause allows the client to terminate without notice or payment for completed work. I propose that either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 30 days prior written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination. - Regarding intellectual property, the relevant clause transfers ownership upon delivery before payment is received. I propose that all intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverable. Please let me know if these updates work for you. Best regards,
